sources.title: Apple reports fourth quarter results (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1), fiscal year ended Sept. 26, 2026

scenes.title: How Apple makes money
scenes.sub: iPhone brings the sales. Services bring the margins.
scenes.sub_html: iPhone brings the sales. Services bring the margins.

lines.say: Apple made four hundred seventy nine billion dollars in sales this year.
lines.show: Apple made $479 billion in sales this year.

lines.say: But the part that keeps the most of each dollar isn't the iPhone.
lines.show: But the part that keeps the most of each dollar isn't the iPhone.

lines.say: The iPhone alone brought in two hundred fifty four billion. That's more than half.
lines.show: The iPhone alone brought in $254 billion. That's more than half.

scenes.label: from the App Store, iCloud and more

lines.say: Services, like the App Store, iCloud and Apple Music, brought in one hundred twenty three billion.
lines.show: Services, like the App Store, iCloud and Apple Music, brought in $123 billion.

lines.say: Here's the trick. On each services dollar, Apple keeps about seventy six cents after direct costs.
lines.show: Here's the trick. On each services dollar, Apple keeps about 76¢ after direct costs.

lines.say: On hardware like the iPhone, it keeps about thirty nine cents.
lines.show: On hardware like the iPhone, it keeps about 39¢.

lines.say: So services are about a quarter of sales, but about forty percent of gross profit.
lines.show: So services are about a quarter of sales, but about 40% of gross profit.

lines.say: After all costs and taxes, Apple kept one hundred thirty two billion dollars.
lines.show: After all costs and taxes, Apple kept $132 billion.

scenes.takeaway: Sell the device once. Charge for services every month.
scenes.source: Data: Apple fiscal 2026 results, SEC filing
